title: ticks' entrypoint still carries the run/reconcile/wave/closeout prompts and phase table ticfac no longer reaches
body: image/entrypoint.sh (vendored from ticks, sandbox.pin.json) still validates a `closeout` and `wave` phase and carries harness prompts for run/reconcile/wave/closeout. ticfac's override bypasses all of them (hn0) and its control plane now never sends closeout (dl8), so those prompts are unreachable from the only consumer that boots this image. A ticks-side cleanup could shrink the entrypoint to the phases that exist; until then the dead weight is vendored and pinned, deliberately untouched here.
